mainIdea.text: After the magic gourd pulled Summer, Ms. Lin, Grandpa, and the seven brothers into the Reverse Valley, the Snake Spirit's spell made every selfish attack dangerous. The group discovered that each special power could create a colored mark only after it helped a companion. Big Brother and Third Brother repaired a bridge, Second Brother and Fifth Brother guided everyone through a hot passage, and Sixth Brother and Fourth Brother rescued Grandpa from a thorny platform. Seventh Brother then changed the magic gourd from a tool that swallowed people into one that carried the final marks safely. Following Grandpa's clue, Summer and Ms. Lin helped the brothers remember the order of their helpful actions. The seven correctly placed marks opened the exit, returned everyone home, and ended the spell.
